pages.task: Subject: "Thorn Whip" lash landing on a target, strongly left-to-right: a thick green thorny vine whip (oak green #62d04b/#2c7a2b, white thorns, a few oak leaves, dark outline) snapping across the cell from the upper left to the middle right. Frame 1: the vine tip curls in from the upper left, S-curved. Frames 2-3: the vine stretches into a fast diagonal arc, speed streaks. Frame 4: the crack: tip hits the centre-right, bright white-green flash star and a puff of air. Frames 5-6: the vine lies across with ripple wave, thorns bristle, torn leaves and green-white sparks burst outward. Frames 7-8: the vine retracts and fades toward the upper left, sparks and leaves fade; frame 8 faint remnant. Nature only, no water, no blood. The impact point stays at the same place (centre-right) from frame 4 on.
pages.checkRules:
- Exactly 2:1, 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal cells; NO grid lines/borders/numbers/text.
- Background really transparent (no black, no magenta residue, no dark halo, no black rectangle); corners and cell borders transparent.
- Every frame fully inside its cell with transparent margin; no content crossing cell borders; no empty frame.
- Frames form one smooth animation: same centre/size logic between neighbours, no sudden jump, frame 1 visible, frame 8 fading remnant.
- One bold readable subject per frame, hand-painted medieval style, no neon/sci-fi/purple/noise, no characters, no text.
- Reads as a thorny green vine whip lash (nature), clear crack/impact flash at frame 4, retraction after; no water, no blood, no character.
- Impact point constant from frame 4; vine thick and bold, not thin noise.
